name: pam_cracklib
detailed_description: Legacy password strength checking module using cracklib library for detection of weak passwords. Checks passwords against dictionary attacks and common patterns. Deprecated in favor of pam_pwquality but still available on Debian-based systems.

parameters.difok: Number of characters different from old password

notes:
Deprecated; use pam_pwquality instead
